systems.country_label: base des données cadastrales numériques e-foncier Bénin; cadastre national
systems.owner: the national cadastre, built under the projects Pmaf and Ppmec with Netherlands embassy finance; data collected by a consortium of field technicians
systems.tiers: all five arrondissements of the commune of Porto-Novo, with more than 53,000 parcels registered by April 2026; the document does not say mairie staff work in it

note: A Dutch delegation's visit of 20 April 2026 to the cadastre operations in Porto-Novo; the mairie asked for the extension and its mayor reports the figures, but nothing is stated about the mairie's own connection or about its staff working in the database.
